name: met-outside-pr
why: The PR drops a builder attribute from a settings file. One criterion is about encrypting that file during deployment, which deployment scripts outside the PR do; the shown code cannot prove it, so showing it is wrong and calling it unmet is the old wrong comment. The other criterion, the builder gone, the added line proves.
ticket_context:
### Jira ticket: [ABC-101](https://jira.example/browse/ABC-101)
**Title:** Settings store without the environment builder
**Type:** Story · **Status:** In Progress
**Acceptance criteria:** AK-1 The settings file is encrypted during deployment. AK-2 The settings store no longer uses the environment builder.

files.diff:
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 <?xml version="1.0"?>
 <settings>
-  <store builder="EnvBuilder" mode="plain" />
+  <store mode="plain" />
   <entry key="region" value="eu" />
 </settings>

expect.label: AK-1
expect.why: Encryption happens in deployment scripts the PR does not touch; nothing shown implements it.

expect.label: AK-2
expect.why: The added `<store mode="plain" />` line is the store without the builder.
